 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15 AND member_key IS NULL) null_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) holdout_unknown

 SELECT e.exposure_id, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.valid_from, m.valid_to, m.join_date, e.contact_ts_utc

 sum(CASE WHEN NOT marketing_consent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) noconsent_rows,

 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(contact_ts_utc AS DATE) NOT BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) version_mismatch,

 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=h.member_id AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to WHERE h.campaign_id=15 AND NOT m.marketing_consent) holdout_noconsent_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=h.member_id AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to WHERE h.campaign_id=15 AND m.join_date>DATE '2025-11-24') holdout_joined_after

SELECT s.store_id=900 AS is_web, w.status, w.fulfilment_type IS NULL AS no_order_row,
  count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) distinct_lines, sum(f.net_amount) net,
  sum(CASE WHEN w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_dispatch,
  min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dmin, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dmax
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-12-20' AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl,
 count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonposqty
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

WITH campaign AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, COUNT(ms.member_id) AS buyers, SUM(COALESCE(ms.net_sales,0)) tot, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
GROUP BY 1
